 Order

The present bail application has been filed on behalf of the petitioner under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, seeking extension of interim bail granted to the petitioner vide order dated 26.05.2025, for a further period of four weeks in case FIR No. 210/2023 dated 15.07.2023 for the offences punishable under Sections 420/468/471 of the Indian Penal Code,
1860, registered at Police Station Sarojini Nagar.
2. The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner was granted interim bail for a period of 45 days as he was suffering from cardiac as well as nephrological problems.
He further submits that the petitioner's condition was critical and he was advised to undergo angiography.
However, the procedure could not be conducted This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 09/07/2025 at 22:24:57 as the petitioner was suffering from hypertension and is also a known case of diabetes.
3. The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner was required to surrender before the concerned Jail Superintendent today.
However, while being admitted at Mahindru Hospital, Uttam Nagar, New Delhi, his condition deteriorated and he has been referred to a higher medical centre for further management.

The petitioner is now admitted in Oncoplus Hospital,
Defence Colony, New Delhi.
4. Fresh medical documents have been filed on behalf of the petitioner, which are taken on record.

The learned counsel further submits that the condition of the petitioner continues to remain Deepak Kumar vs State on 9 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/6314481/
1 unstable, and the doctor has opined as under:
"Severe LV Dysfunction (EF=20-25%) Grade III LV DD/Mild MR/Moderate TR PAH/IVC Dilated/CHF Accelerated HTN & urgency/CKD grade II-III K/C/O T2DM/HTn/CKD (on Rx)"
5. Let all the medical documents be verified by the concerned SHO/IO and a detailed verification report be filed before the next date of hearing.
6. The interim bail granted to the petitioner is further extended till 18.07.2025 on the same terms and conditions as contained in the order dated 26.05.2025 7.
